bugs.what: Sealed coffer remains shown as sealed after successful will check to open it; no visual inventory or 'you have the crown' feedback. Game state tracked it correctly, but UI was confusing.
bugs.where: Elder's House, after ask elder: sealed coffer success

confusions: After opening the coffer via will check, the scene still showed 'sealed iron coffer' with no 'take crown' option; crown was obtained but not explicitly displayed
The 'kneel and take his crown (surrender)' option was unclear — unclear if it meant something different than 'return the crown'
suggestions: Add explicit 'you obtain: crown' message or inventory line when picking up key items
Update scene descriptions after major state changes (e.g., 'the coffer lies open' after successful will check)
Clarify what the 'surrender' option does or rename it to match its actual mechanic
Consider showing a brief status line with carried items, especially key quest objects
